input.summary: Add exclusive New York County forum to Section 10.5, retaining existing New York governing law.
input.comment: [Playbook] New York law is already our preferred position, but the Agreement names no forum, so we have added exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts in New York County, with only temporary injunctive relief available elsewhere.

ops.oldText: without giving effect to the principles of conflict of laws.
ops.newText: without giving effect to the principles of conflict of laws. The state and federal courts located in New York County, New York shall have exclusive jurisdiction over the merits of any dispute arising out of or relating to this Agreement, provided that either Party may seek temporary injunctive relief in any other court of competent jurisdiction.
